summary: Nudge a seat that sits idle holding claimed work with nothing set to wake it, once, naming the step and its waits, and record the nudge on the step

replay.detail: No shared projection replay is needed. A new disposable local message index is populated during first startup and maintained on claim writes; reads never populate or rebuild it.

schema.detail: Two additive lookup indexes select watches by recipient and report-to runs by reporter. local_idle_messages is a disposable local table with two indexes and three claim-lifecycle triggers: pending input and last delivered source wakes are indexed reads instead of mailbox-history scans. Startup backfill commits at most 64 message subjects per transaction and resumes after interruption. No shared tables or columns change. The claim vocabulary gains work.nudged (system-only, append, on step-run) with optional attempt, agent, message, idle_since_unix_ms, reason and waits fields. The client contract adds optional nudged_at_unix_ms to work and nudged_at to mission steps.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and their digests are unchanged. The claim registry digest changes with the new kind, as with any vocabulary addition: members on different builds keep replicating claims and skip comparing projection maps until all are upgraded.

compatibility.detail: A member on an older build does not know work.nudged, so it holds a replicated nudge as unknown and admits it after it upgrades. A seat on an older host is never nudged, because only the host that runs a seat evaluates it. [reconcile] gains idle_nudge_after (default 30m, or off) and idle_nudge_quiet_watch (default 2h). A config that sets either one fails to load on an older build, because [reconcile] denies unknown fields. Not tested against an older build.

downtime.detail: First startup creates the additive lookup indexes before requests are admitted. CREATE INDEX holds the SQLite writer during creation. On a copy of the 200,790-claim benchmark store with 700 declarations, five report-index creations including commit had a 69.4 ms median and 1,980.7 ms maximum; watch-index creation had a 19.6 ms median and 19.8 ms maximum. The initial report-index execution alone took 92.8 ms, and a concurrent writer was refused during it. These are measured startup costs, not bounds for larger stores. Initial local message-index backfill took 1,148.6 ms for 5,125 messages in 81 transactions of at most 64 subjects; the longest writer batch was 35.2 ms. Restart after successful backfill only checks its marker. Idle checks run in the existing incremental seat wake evaluation and register their next deadlines; they add no sampler or polling thread. Pending mailbox and child-seat reads happen only when a nudge can be sent.

manual.detail: On by default. Turn it off with idle_nudge_after = "off" under [reconcile]; the daemon reads it again within two minutes. The guide is in docs/st3/mission-graph-runtime.md under Idle holders.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary at any time. Nudges stop, and work.nudged claims stay in the graph unread. The disposable local_idle_messages table, indexes and triggers can remain; older binaries ignore the table. Schema setup for a newer build resumes an interrupted message-index backfill.
